messages:
Zoe (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get a short status update for API / Console / Optimize timelines? I'm trying to summarize for partners. Please reply with one-line status + any blockers.

Mara (Product): API: aiming for GA in mid-Aug. We have a 2-week dev preview next week. Main open item is auth v2 rollout + SDK parity.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirming dev preview starts Mon 2024-04-29. Auth v2 rollout is the biggest risk; PR to rotate tokens landed but needs infra deploy.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: feature parity for route-level analytics planned for July end. Canary for new dashboard next Friday. Blocking: telemetry schema change needs docs update.

DevRel Bot: Posted: /release-plan api-dev-preview -> prod-canary scheduled Mon 2024-04-29 09:00 UTC :calendar: 

Alex (Optimize): Optimize (cost recommendations): MVP for intelligent batching suggestions is feature-complete; we're running internal evals. Public beta target: early Aug if evals pass.

Sam (Docs): I'll queue the telemetry schema doc edits today. ETA for doc PR: Wed. Will sync with Jess on wording for Console changelog.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: deploying auth v2 requires a short maintenance window for dedicated customers (we're aiming to avoid user-visible downtime, but routing switch may cause 2-3 min lag for long-lived connections). Need to confirm SLA implications.

Kevin L (Eng): Quick snippet for the auth toggle we'll roll: 
```
# temporary toggle for auth v2
FEATURE_AUTH_V2=true
ROLLOUT_PERCENT=10
```
We'll ramp to 100% over 48 hours if no red flags.

Mara (Product): Leadership ask: what's the minimum public messaging we should prepare for next week's preview? One-sentence per product (API/Console/Optimize).

Zoe (CEO): Good — please post suggested messaging in this thread by EOD so comms can draft. Keep it high-level and non-promising.

Jess (Eng PM): Drafts: 
- API: "Dev preview: faster routing and new auth v2 for improved security; seeking feedback."
- Console: "Canary: new route analytics dashboard available to opt-in users; feedback requested."
- Optimize: "Beta: automated batching suggestions to help reduce per-token cost for typical web workloads."

Mara (Product): Adding dependencies: Console analytics requires API telemetry schema v2 (Sam + Kevin coordinating). Optimize beta depends on stable KV caching perf (Alex + Riley are running perf tests).

Riley (SRE): Perf tests show KV cache P99 latency within target for 95% of traces; we still need one more run with larger seq-len distribution.

Sam (Docs): I'll prepare three short bullets for marketing and support knowledge base.

Ops (Release): Can we get a final sign-off by Fri 17:00 UTC on the rollout plan? I need to lock the canary windows.

Kevin L (Eng): We're on track for sign-off barring any regressions in the next two perf runs.

Alex (Optimize): One request: please add a checkbox in the opt-in flow that lets customers opt out of auto-quant suggestions (privacy/compat reasons). I'll file the ticket.

Mara (Product): Noted, Alex — add the ticket and link it here.

DevRel Bot: Ticket created: OPS-8245 "opt-out for auto-quant suggestions" by Alex.

Zoe (CEO): Thanks all. I'll update partners with a one-paragraph summary after EOD once we have the messaging. If anything slips, ping me here. :thumbsup:
